"""CWE-89 safe: parameterized execute with bound args."""


def find_user(cur, user_id):
    cur.execute("SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?", (user_id,))


def find_by_name(cur, name):
    cur.execute("SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = %s", (name,))
